gloss: all things in heaven and earth; all of creation

definitions.gloss: all things in heaven and earth; all of creation
definitions.explanation: Everything that exists in the universe — the whole of nature and all the things within it.

examples.japanese: {天地万物|てんちばんぶつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{創造|そうぞう}する→創造する：29393_souzousuru⟧。
examples.english: Create all things in heaven and earth.

examples.japanese: {天地万物|てんちばんぶつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{命|いのち}→命：02371_inochi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{宿|やど}る→宿る：12351_yadoru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{考|かんが}えられて→考える：00856_kangaeru⟧きた。
examples.english: It has long been believed that life dwells in all things of creation.

examples.japanese: ⟦{古代|こだい}→古代：05324_kodai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人々|ひとびと}→人々：03141_hitobito⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{天地万物|てんちばんぶつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{神|かみ}→神：02147_kami⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{宿|やど}っている→宿る：12351_yadoru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{信|しん}じていた→信じる：01111_shinjiru⟧。
examples.english: The people of ancient times believed that gods dwelled in all things of heaven and earth.

notes:
A four-character idiom (⟦{四字熟語|よじじゅくご}→四字熟語：15663_yojijukugo⟧) made of {天地|てんち} (heaven and earth) + ⟦{万物|ばんぶつ}→万物：20516_banbutsu⟧ (all things). Literary and somewhat philosophical or religious in tone.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {天地万物|てんちばんぶつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{創造|そうぞう}→創造：03317_souzou⟧: the creation of all things
- {天地万物|てんちばんぶつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{支配|しはい}する→支配する：25222_shihaisuru⟧: to rule over all of creation

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{森羅万象|しんらばんしょう}→森羅万象：06149_shinrabanshou⟧: all things in the universe — a close synonym, even more sweeping in scope
- ⟦{万物|ばんぶつ}→万物：20516_banbutsu⟧: all things — the plainer component word, used on its own
